description: The Red Bull RB9 was a Formula One racing car built by Red Bull for the 2013 Formula One season. It is the ninth generation of Red Bull car, and the successor to the World Championship winning Red Bull RB8. It was driven by reigning World Drivers' Champion, Sebastian Vettel, and his Australian team-mate, Mark Webber.
